label: Rice (paddy equivalent)
formula: paddy_equivalent_yield = milled_yield / 0.67; paddy_equivalent_production = milled_production / 0.67; area unchanged
assumption: A fixed approximate milling recovery used for display harmonization; not a measured rate for every source, region, or year.
overlap_rule: Select one full source series per country, unit, season, and area basis: prefer a paddy series with eligible observations; otherwise use milled. Source choice uses available record and stays fixed across period changes. Do not add or splice reporting forms.
fit_conversion: Add log(weight_multiplier) to the log-yield intercept. Keep time and ENSO slopes, coefficient covariance, CV skill, fitting years, and eligibility unchanged. ENSO responses relative to neutral and their intervals are invariant.
raw_data: global/data/2026-09-26/observations/; original source JSON files and release checksums remain unchanged

reference.title: Cadoni and Angelucci (2013), Analysis of incentives and disincentives for rice in Nigeria, FAO MAFAP
reference.note: Uses a milled/paddy conversion ratio of 0.67. Adoption across this atlas is our harmonization assumption.

recovery_context.title: IRRI Rice Knowledge Bank: Milling yields
recovery_context.note: Reports typical modern multistage mill recoveries of 65–70%, with variation by milling system and paddy quality.
